<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<title>Cyber Threat & Intelligence Dossier</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #F8FAFC;
    --card: #FFFFFF;
    --border: #E2E8F0;
    --ink: #0F172A;
    --text: #334155;
    --muted: #64748B;
    --brand: #4338CA;
    --brand-light: #EEF2FF;
    --red: #E11D48;
    --red-bg: #FFE4E6;
    --green: #059669;
    --green-bg: #D1FAE5;
    --amber: #D97706;
    --amber-bg: #FEF3C7;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: 13.5px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .page {
    max-width: 880px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 32px;
    page-break-after: always;
  }
  .doc-header {
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--brand);
    padding-bottom: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-end;
  }
  .doc-header .logo-area h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    color: var(--brand);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .doc-header .logo-area h1 {
    margin: 6px 0 0 0;
    font-size: 22px;
    color: var(--ink);
    font-weight: 800;
  }
  .doc-header .meta-stamp {
    text-align: right;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
  }

  .stat-band {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .stat-tile {
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    break-inside: avoid !important;
  }
  .stat-tile .num {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .stat-tile .lbl {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .section-card {
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px 22px;
    margin-bottom: 22px;
    break-inside: avoid !important;
  }
  .section-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 16px 0;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--ink);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .bar-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
  }
  .bar-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .bar-label {
    width: 90px;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 500;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .bar-track {
    flex: 1;
    background: #F1F5F9;
    border-radius: 6px;
    height: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .bar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 6px;
  }
  .bar-count {
    width: 50px;
    text-align: right;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--ink);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .tag-cloud {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
  }
  .tag-chip {
    background: var(--brand-light);
    color: var(--brand);
    border: 1px solid #C7D2FE;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .post-card {
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    background: #FAFBFD;
    break-inside: avoid !important;
  }
  .post-meta {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .post-text {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .sentiment-chip {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-left: 6px;
  }
  .sentiment-chip.negative { background: var(--red-bg); color: var(--red); }
  .sentiment-chip.neutral { background: #E2E8F0; color: #475569; }
  .sentiment-chip.positive { background: var(--green-bg); color: var(--green); }

  table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 12.5px;
  }
  th {
    text-align: left;
    background: #F8FAFC;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 9px 12px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
  }
  td {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .footer-bar {
    margin-top: 30px;
    padding-top: 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  }
</style>
</head>
